page.overview:
What is Ambush near the Degan Gas Clouds?

In 1 ABY, the Khuiumin Survivors ambushed the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Brazen near the Degan Gas Clouds.

The Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Brazen managed to escape the battle and went to Derilyn to receive temporary repairs on its engines at the facilities of the Derilyn Space Defense Platform. The plan was to perform limited repairs on the Star Destroyer so that it would be able to reach a fully-equipped Imperial Navy shipyard, most probably a deepdock facility located towards the Metharian Nebula. However, the Brazen was destroyed by Rebel agents who infiltrated the Derilyn Space Defense Platform.
